describe: Illustrated fantasy learning-map backdrop: floating grassy islands with waterfalls, a glowing dotted purple/blue path winding between them, a crystal spire city and pastel sky-city skyline on the right, a small ringed planet upper right, big soft clouds, and a large curved white window arch framing the left side. The child Aarav and the white-and-blue robot Nova ride a glowing white hover-car in the centre.
